notes: «جَمِيعاً» : the father («أبي», relation) and Ali ibn Muhammad ibn Majilawayh both narrate from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdillah al-Barqi: one level of two, then the next name (rule 2)
The Imam al-Rida speaks inside Husayn's account («فَقَالَ الرِّضَا»): he is the last link (owner ruling 5)
«عبد اللهبن» is copied as the text has it, without the space
